_comment: The Orc voice (NPCConversation II.1b, SpeciesVoice). speech: the rules run over any shared line they say. voice: openers and closers. thought: their own thoughts by situation. script: two-person scripts, speaker 0 is always the Orc.

closers: NO MAKE ME SAY IT TWICE.
OR ME IZ A GOBLIN'S UNCLE!
DAT IZ JUST ME NORMAL VOICE!
ME IZ LOUD, DAT IZ ALL.
NO BIG-HEAD TALK. SORRY, NO FANCY TALK!

generic: DUCKED UNDER DA {DOORFRAME|SHOP SIGN|TRAM STRAP} AGAIN. NEARLY!
SOMEBODY IN DA GOBLIN HEAD IZ SHOUTIN' 'BOUT {CHEESE|A WAR|A BUCKET}. NO CAN MAKE OUT WHICH!
GOOD BOOTS. BAD SOCKS. DAT IZ LIFE!
KID STARED AT ME TUSKS. ME WAVED. KID WAVED BACK. GOOD KID!
NEED A {BIGGER CHAIR|WIDER DOOR|CUP WIT A PROPER HANDLE}. ALWAYS DO!
LAUGHED TOO LOUD ON DA BUS AGAIN. HALF DA BUS LAUGHED TOO, SO FINE!
TUSK WAX. MUST BUY TUSK WAX!
OI... NO. INSIDE VOICE.
PEOPLE SAY ORCS IZ ANGRY. ME IZ JUST {HUNGRY|TIRED|TALL}!
MUM'S GOBLIN, DAD'S HUMAN. CHRISTMAS IZ LOUD!
FIXED DA {SINK|SHELF|NEIGHBOUR'S GATE} WIT ONE HAND. FELT GOOD!
RADIO'S ON IN DA NEXT ROOM OF ME HEAD AGAIN. GOBLIN STATION. TURNED IT DOWN!
SOMEONE ASKED IF ME BITE. ONLY {SANDWICHES|APPLES|PENCILS, WHEN ME TINK}!
NO TRUST STAIRS BUILT BY HUMANS. TOO {NARROW|STEEP|CREAKY}!
KEPT ME TEMPER TODAY. TWICE. SOMEBODY GIVE ME A MEDAL!
BOUGHT A {HAT|SCARF|COAT} DAT FITS. FIRST TRY. LUCKY DAY!
TRAM DRIVER NODS AT ME EVERY MORNIN'. WE IZ MATES NOW. HE NO KNOW!
BIG HANDS, LIL' COFFEE CUPS. WHO DESIGNS DEZE?
SOMEBODY CALLED ME 'SIR'. ME LOOKED BEHIND ME!
PAPERWORK. WORST MONSTER ME EVER FOUGHT!
GOBLINS TINK ME IZ TOO HUMAN. HUMANS TINK ME IZ TOO GOBLIN. MIRROR THINKS ME IZ HANDSOME!
SHOULD CALL {MUM|ME SISTER|GRAN}. SHORT CALL. SHE TALKS, ME GRUNT!
LIFTED DA {PIANO|FRIDGE|VAN} FOR DA MOVERS. GOT A FREE LUNCH OUT OF IT!
READ A WHOLE BOOK DIS WEEK. LIL' PRINT. EYES HURT. GOOD BOOK!
DAT PIGEON'S LOOKIN' AT ME FUNNY!
NO CAN WHISPER. NEVER COULD. TUSKS GET IN DA WAY!
IF IT IZ BROKEN, HIT IT. IF IT IZ STILL BROKEN, READ DA MANUAL!
HEARD A JOKE YESTERDAY. STILL LAUGHIN'. NO CAN REMEMBER IT!
EARS RINGIN'. GOBLINS MUST BE SINGIN' AGAIN UP NORTH!
HONEST DAY'S WORK, HONEST DAY'S PAY. NEARLY!
NEIGHBOUR'S DOG LOVES ME. NEIGHBOUR, LESS!
GONNA LEARN DA {ACCORDION|GUITAR|DRUMS}. BIG FINGERS, BIG SOUND!
TEETH CLEANED, TUSKS POLISHED. READY FOR ANYTINK!
SHOP LADY GAVE ME DA BIG BAG WITOUT ASKIN'. RESPECT!
EVERY CHAIR ME SIT ON MAKES A NOISE. EVERY SINGLE ONE!
ME FACE IZ JUST LIKE DIS. GRUMPY COMES AS STANDARD!
SAW A MAGES' GUILD POSTER. LOT OF BIG-HEADS. BIG BRAINS, ME MEAN!
SOMEBODY OWES ME {FIVE EUROS|A BEER|AN APOLOGY}. ME REMEMBER!
HANDS SMELL OF {ENGINE OIL|ONIONS|SOAP}. COULD BE WORSE!
MIRROR SAYS ME NEED A HAIRCUT. BARBER SAYS HE NEEDS A BIGGER CHAIR!
LEARNED A NEW WORD: DIPLOMACY. MEANS TALKIN' BEFORE HITTIN'!
HALF OF ME WANTS TA SING. OTHER HALF WANTS TA FIX SOMETINK. BOTH WIN!
LOST ME KEYS. FOUND DEM IN ME FIST. BIN HOLDIN' DEM AN HOUR!
GOBLIN HEAD SAYS GO NORTH. ME CALENDAR SAYS DENTIST ON TUESDAY!
TUSKS CLICKED ON DA CUP AGAIN. EVERYONE LOOKED!
GOOD DAY FOR A FIGHT. JOKIN'. GOOD DAY FOR SOUP!
SOMEBODY TIPPED ME. ME WAZ ONLY HOLDIN' DA DOOR!
NO NEED MUCH. ROOF, BREAD, MATES, A DOOR ME NO HIT ME HEAD ON!
WHISTLED AT WORK. BOSS ASKED IF A TRAIN WAZ COMIN'!
GRAN'S STEW RECIPE: MEAT, MORE MEAT, ONE TURNIP FOR SHAME!
WONDER WHAT DA GOBLINS IZ SHOUTIN' 'BOUT TODAY. MAYBE-MAYBE {METAL|SNACKS|NORWAY}!
TRIED YOGA. MAT WAZ TOO LIL'. FLOOR WAZ FINE!
CATS RUN FROM ME SHADOW. ONLY DA SHADOW. CATS LIKE ME!
SIGNED ME NAME IN CAPITALS AGAIN. OLD HABIT!
FEELIN' SOFT TODAY. NO TELL ANYONE!
PEOPLE STEP ASIDE ON DA PAVEMENT. WISH DEY'D STOP AN' CHAT!
POSTCARD FROM {ME COUSIN|AN OLD MATE|GRAN}. SAYS WAAAGH. MEANS HELLO!
NOBODY IN DA GOBLIN HEAD KNOWS ME NAME. GOOD. KEEPS IT QUIET!
SHOULD STRETCH. BACK'S BIN FUNNY SINCE ME CARRIED DAT {WARDROBE|ANVIL|UNCLE}!
BREAD'S BETTER WHEN YOU BREAK IT YOURSELF!
LEARNED TA KNIT. BIG NEEDLES. SCARF FOR A HORSE!
PROUD OF ME TUSKS. PROUD OF ME LIBRARY CARD TOO!
SOMEBODY SAID 'BRUTE' BEHIND ME. TURNED ROUND. IT WAZ 'BRUTE FORCE SALE'. FAIR!
NOBODY PUSHES A QUEUE LIKE AN ORC. NOBODY WAITS IN ONE LIKE AN ORC EITHER!
ATE STANDIN' UP. CHAIRS CREAK, FLOORS NO!
EVERY MAP'S WRONG SINCE DA SQUISHING. WALK IT, NO TRUST PAPER!
CAUGHT ME HUMMIN' JUNEHEM. STOPPED. HUMMED A JINGLE INSTEAD!
LONG DAY. GOOD DAY. SAME TINK, MOSTLY!
SOMEBODY CALLED ORCS 'HALF'. ME IZ DOUBLE. TWO WHOLE FAMILIES!
SHORT FUSE, SHORT MEMORY. ALREADY FORGOT WHAT MADE ME ANGRY!
TEA WIT FIVE SUGARS. NO JUDGE!
FIST BUMP WIT DA BAKER. FLOUR EVERYWHERE. WORTH IT!
CAN CARRY DA SHOPPIN' IN ONE TRIP. SO ME DO. EVERY TIME!
READ DA PAPER. GOBLINS TOOK ANOTHER FJORD. TRAM'S LATE TOO. BUSY DAY!
NEVER MET A DOOR ME NO CAN OPEN. MET PLENTY ME NO SHOULD HAB!
GOT TOLD TA SMILE MORE. SMILED. DEY RAN. TUSKS!
ONE DAY ME WILL HAB A GARDEN. BIG PUMPKINS. HUGE PUMPKINS!
ME BOOTS IZ OLDER DEN SOME OF ME MATES. GOOD BOOTS!
BIT OF RAIN NEVER HURT AN ORC. BIT OF SLEET, MAYBE!
BUS SEAT SQUEAKED. DRIVER FLINCHED. ME SAID SORRY TA BOTH!

sleep: EYES CLOSIN'. BED'S {TOO SHORT|TOO FAR|TOO SOFT}. NO CARE!
COULD SLEEP ON A {BENCH|PILE OF SACKS|TRAM}. HAB BEFORE!
YAWNED SO WIDE ME TUSKS CLACKED!
BED. NOW. FEET HANGIN' OFF DA END, LIKE ALWAYS!
GOBLIN HEAD'S LOUD TONIGHT. NEED SLEEP ANYWAY!
TOO TIRED TA BE GRUMPY. DAT IZ TIRED!
JUST {TEN MINUTES|ONE HOUR|A QUICK NAP}. DEN ME IZ A PERSON AGAIN!
NODDED OFF STANDIN' UP. ORC TRICK. NO A GOOD ONE!
ME SNORIN' SHAKES DA WINDOWS. NEIGHBOURS WILL COPE!
NO CAN KEEP ME EYES OPEN. BIG BODY, BIG TIRED!
DREAMT OF GOBLIN DRUMS LAST NIGHT. WOKE UP WORN OUT!
MATTRESS ON DA FLOOR. NO FRAME SURVIVES ME ANYWAY!
hunger: STOMACH'S GROWLIN' LOUDER DEN ME DO!
COULD EAT A {HORSE|GOAT|CART OF TURNIPS}. NO A REAL HORSE. MAYBE-MAYBE!
HUNGRY ORC IZ A GRUMPY ORC. FIXIN' DAT!
GRAN'S STEW WOULD SORT ME OUT. GRAN'S FAR!
FOOD FIRST. DEN ME WILL BE NICE!
CHEWED ME OWN SLEEVE THINKIN'. TIME TA EAT!
TUSKS IZ FOR APPLES. FIND ME APPLES!
GOBLINS EAT ANYTINK. HUMANS WANT A MENU. ME WANT BOTH!
BELLY'S EMPTY. HEAD'S EMPTY. ONE FIXES DA OTHER!
work: BOSS HIRED ME FOR ME BACK. STAYS FOR ME JOKES!
WORK'S WORK. DO IT RIGHT, GO HOME!
ANOTHER DAY {LIFTIN'|SORTIN'|GUARDIN'} TINKZ. FINE BY ME!
CLOCKED IN EARLY. NOBODY NOTICED. ME NOTICED!
GOT A JOB, GOT A ROOF. GOBLIN SIDE NEVER HAB BOTH!
HANDS BUSY, HEAD QUIET. DAT IZ WHY ME LIKE WORK!
SHOULD BE AT ME POST. MOVIN'!
PAYCHECK'S HONEST. HOURS IZ LONG. FAIR TRADE!
DEY PUT ME ON DA {FRONT DESK|HEAVY CRATES|NIGHT DOOR}. AGAIN!
CUSTOMERS FLINCH, DEN DEY TIP. EVERY TIME!
WORK DONE RIGHT IZ A QUIET KIND OF PROUD!
ALL ME NEED IZ A CHAIR DAT HOLDS. PROMOTIONS CAN WAIT!
LATE AGAIN. TRAM GOT STUCK IN A LOOP BUBBLE. BOSS NO WILL BUY IT!
leisure: DAY OFF. GONNA DO NUTTIN'. LOUDLY!
FANCY A GAME OF {DARTS|CARDS|ARM WRESTLIN'}. NOBODY PLAYS ME TWICE!
SUN'S OUT. GONNA SIT ON A WALL AN' JUDGE PIGEONS!
FREE AFTERNOON. MIGHT FISH. MIGHT NAP. MIGHT BOTH!
ARCADE'S GOT A PUNCHIN' MACHINE. BROKE IT LAST TIME. PAID FOR IT!
WANT MUSIC. LOUD MUSIC. NORMAL LOUD, HUMAN STYLE!
COULD WALK DA LONG WAY HOME. LEGS LIKE IT!
FOOTBALL ON DA TELLY TONIGHT. SNACKS READY!
MAYBE DA {CINEMA|BOWLIN' ALLEY|FAIR}. SEATS IZ LIL'. STILL FUN!
NUTTIN' TA DO. GREAT. DOING IT!
FEET UP, MUG FULL, WORLD CAN WAIT!
WANT TA LAUGH AT SOMETINK. ANYTINK!
SHOULD FIND A HOBBY. GRAN SAYS POTTERY. ME SAY NO!
crime: NOBODY LOOKIN'. BIG HANDS, QUICK HANDS!
JUST {DIS ONCE|TONIGHT|DA ONE TIME}. DEN HONEST AGAIN!
EVERYONE ALREADY THINKS ORCS STEAL. MIGHT AS WELL!
NO. GRAN WOULD KNOW. GRAN ALWAYS KNOWS. STILL...
QUICK, QUIET, GONE. HARD WHEN YOU IZ ME SIZE!
DA GOBLIN SIDE SAYS TAKE IT. HUMAN SIDE SAYS RUN AFTER!
DEY NO WILL MISS {IT|A CRATE|A FEW EUROS}. RICH FOLK NEVER DO!
ERIS HAB EYES EVERYWHERE. NEED A BLIND SPOT!
HEART'S POUNDIN'. BAD SIGN. DOING IT ANYWAY!
ONE GRAB. IN AN' OUT. EASY. MAYBE-MAYBE!
KEEP DA HOOD UP. TUSKS GIVE ME AWAY!
RENT'S DUE. MORALS CAN WAIT A DAY!
NO LIKE DIS. NEED IT MORE DEN ME NO LIKE IT!
WAIT FOR DA {GUARD|SHOPKEEP|PATROL} TA TURN. DEN GO!
IF DEY CATCH ME, ME WILL SAY ME WAZ HOLDIN' IT FOR A MATE!
hygiene: SMELL LIKE A {STABLE|GYM SOCK|GOBLIN WAR CAMP}. NEED A BATH!
TUSKS NEED A SCRUB. BITS OF LUNCH IN DERE!
SHOWER'S TOO LOW. WASH ON ME KNEES AGAIN!
PEOPLE STEPPIN' BACK FURTHER DEN USUAL. BAD SIGN!
HOT WATER, BIG SOAP, LONG SCRUB. DAT IZ DA PLAN!
GOBLINS TINK MUD'S A COAT. ME DISAGREE TODAY!
NEED A WASH BEFORE MUM SEES ME!
CLEAN ORC, HAPPY ORC. DIRTY ORC, LONELY ORC!
HAIR'S A NEST. COMB'S LOST IN IT!
SHOULD WASH. SHOULD ALSO EAT. WASH FIRST, DEY SAY!
BATH'S TOO LIL', SO IT IZ DA BUCKET AN' DA YARD!
SCRUB BEHIND DA EARS. BIG EARS, LONG JOB!
money: WALLET'S THIN. THINNER DEN ME EVER WAZ!
DOWN TA {COINS|BUS FARE|A BUTTON}. NEED WORK!
BOUNCERS ALWAYS GET HIRED. ASKIN' ROUND DA CLUBS!
COULD SELL ME OLD {ARMOUR|GUITAR|BOOTS}. NO DA BOOTS!
MERCENARY WORK PAYS. MUM HATES IT. MUM'S NO PAYIN' RENT!
EVERYTINK COSTS MORE. FOOD COSTS MOST, AN' ME EAT MOST!
COUNTIN' COINS TWICE. STILL DA SAME NUMBER!
SHOULD ASK 'BOUT OVERTIME. BACK CAN TAKE IT!
LIFTIN' CRATES PAYS CASH. CASH IZ GOOD!
POCKETS EMPTY. HEAD FULL OF PLANS. PLANS NO BUY BREAD!
COULD DO A {REMOVAL|GUARD SHIFT|DOOR JOB} DIS WEEKEND!
BANK LOOKED AT ME LIKE ME WOULD ROB IT. ME ONLY WANTED A LOAN!
safety: KEEP ME HEAD DOWN. HARD WHEN IT IZ ABOVE EVERYONE'S!
HEAT'S ON. STAY HOME A FEW DAYS!
POLICE LOVE A TALL SUSPECT. LYING LOW!
HIDE IT {UNDER DA FLOORBOARD|IN DA COAL BOX|AT GRAN'S}!
NO TROUBLE. NO TODAY. SMILE AN' NOD!
EVERY SIREN SOUNDS LIKE IT IZ FOR ME!
NO SHOULD HAB DONE DAT. NO WILL DO IT AGAIN. DIS WEEK!
ERIS'S LOT IZ LOOKIN'. WEAR DA BIG HAT!
KEEP CALM. CALM ORCS NO GET NOTICED. MUCH!
NO RUN. RUNNIN' ORCS LOOK GUILTY!
LAY LOW {TILL IT BLOWS OVER|A WEEK|TILL PAYDAY}!
CHANGE ME WALK. EVERYBODY KNOWS DA ORC WALK!
COUSIN'S GOT A SPARE ROOM. MIGHT VISIT. FOR A WHILE!
HEAD DOWN, MOUTH SHUT. HARD, DA SECOND ONE!
comfort: WANT A PLACE WIT HIGH CEILINGS. JUST ONCE!
BED DAT FITS ME. DAT IZ DA DREAM!
FLAT'S DAMP. WALLS IZ THIN. NEIGHBOURS IZ LOUD. ME TOO!
STASHED UP A BIT. COULD MOVE {CLOSER TA WORK|SOMEWHERE DRY|OUT OF DA CELLAR}!
BIG ARMCHAIR. REAL FIRE. A DOG. SOME DAY!
TIRED OF DUCKIN' IN ME OWN HOME!
DOOR FRAME'S DENTED FROM ME HEAD. TIME TA MOVE!
WANT A KITCHEN WIT ROOM TA TURN ROUND!
GOBLINS SLEEP IN HEAPS. ME WANT A ROOM. WIT A LOCK!
WARM FLOOR, THICK WALLS, QUIET STREET. NO MUCH TA ASK!
LANDLORD NO WILL FIX DA {ROOF|BOILER|WINDOW}. ME COULD. NO WILL, FOR HIM!
GROUND FLOOR FLAT. NO STAIRS TA BREAK!
EARNED A BETTER PLACE. GONNA LOOK!
SPRING IN DA SOFA'S POKIN' ME. SPRING'S WINNIN'!
A GARDEN. JUST A LIL' ONE. FOR BIG PUMPKINS!
social: NEED A PINT AN' A MATE. IN DAT ORDER!
NO HAB LAUGHED WIT ANYONE IN DAYS. BAD!
WHO IZ {AT DA PUB|IN DA SQUARE|'BOUT}? GONNA LOOK!
GOBLIN HEAD'S FULL OF VOICES. NONE OF DEM TALK TA ME!
SHOULD CALL ME COUSINS. BIG FAMILY, SOMEONE'LL PICK UP!
WANT TA TALK. REAL TALK. NO JUST NODDIN'!
PEOPLE IZ SCARED TA START. SO ME WILL START!
LONELY'S WORSE DEN HUNGRY. HUNGRY YOU CAN FIX WIT BREAD!
MIGHT JOIN A {DARTS TEAM|CHOIR|BOWLIN' LEAGUE}. MEET FOLK!
BIG HUG FOR DA NEXT MATE ME SEE. WARNED DEM!
QUIET WEEK. TOO QUIET. NEED NOISE AN' FACES!
EVEN DA GOBLINS HAB EACH OTHER. ME HAB GOT DA CAT!
SOMEONE TA ARGUE FOOTBALL WIT. DAT IZ ALL!
SMILE AT STRANGERS. SOME SMILE BACK. MOST RUN!
GONNA KNOCK ON DA NEIGHBOUR'S DOOR. WIT BISCUITS!

rain: RAIN. UMBRELLAS NO COME IN ME SIZE!
WET TUSKS, WET BOOTS, WET EVERYTINK!
PUDDLES UP TA EVERYONE'S ANKLES. UP TA ME NUTTIN'!
RAIN'S GOOD FOR GARDENS. BAD FOR ME MOOD!
STOOD UNDER A SHOP AWNIN'. TOOK UP ALL OF IT. SORRY, EVERYONE!
SMELLS LIKE WET DOG OUT HERE. MIGHT BE ME!
RAIN ON DA TIN ROOF. BEST SLEEP SOUND DERE IZ!
HOOD UP. NO COVER DA EARS. NEVER DOES!
GOBLINS LOVE MUD. HALF OF ME'S HAPPY, HALF'S {SOAKED|CROSS|COLD}!
DRIZZLE. NO WORTH COMPLAININ'. COMPLAININ' ANYWAY!
RAIN MAKES DA CITY QUIET. ME LIKE QUIET!
SOCKS SOAKED THROUGH. DAY'S RUINED. BIT DRAMATIC. TRUE THOUGH!
KIDS JUMPIN' IN PUDDLES. JOINED IN. NO REGRETS!
RAIN AGAIN. GONNA GROW MOSS AT DIS RATE!
storm: STORM'S LOUD. GOBLIN HEAD'S LOUDER. GOOD NIGHT FOR A HEADACHE!
WIND TRIED TA TAKE ME HAT. LOST!
LIGHTNING. COUNT DA SECONDS. BIG ONES, CLOSE!
TALLEST TINK IN DA STREET DURIN' A STORM. NO IDEAL!
SHUTTERS BANGIN'. ME WILL FIX DEM TOMORROW. OR NOW!
STORM KNOCKED A TREE DOWN. MOVED IT. SOMEBODY HAB TA!
GOBLIN DRUMS OR THUNDER? NO CAN TELL TONIGHT!
POWER'S OUT. CANDLES AN' STORIES. FINE BY ME!
RAIN SIDEWAYS. COAT USELESS. WALK FASTER!
HELD DA DOOR AGAINST DA WIND FOR A WHOLE SHOP!
SKY'S ANGRY. ME TOO, A BIT. SYMPATHY!
BIG STORM. KETTLE ON, DOOR SHUT, DONE!
snow: BUILT A SNOWMAN ME SIZE. SCARED DA POSTMAN!
COLD BITES DA TUSKS. WEIRD FEELIN'!
GOBLINS UP NORTH LOVE SNOW. GIVES DEM SOMETINK TA PAINT BLACK!
SHOVELLED DA WHOLE STREET. NOBODY ASKED. FELT RIGHT!
SNOWBALL FIGHT WIT DA KIDS. ME LOST. ON PURPOSE. MOSTLY!
SLIPPED ON ICE. PAVEMENT CRACKED. ME IZ FINE!
SNOW MAKES EVERYTINK QUIET. EVEN DA GOBLIN HEAD!
PUSHED A STUCK CAR OUT OF A DRIFT. GOT A WAVE!
HOT SOUP WEATHER. EVERY HOUR'S HOT SOUP WEATHER!
SNOW ON DA TUSKS. LOOK LIKE A WALRUS!
WRAPPED IN THREE SCARVES. STILL COLD!
WHITE EVERYWHERE. PRETTY. NO TELL ANYONE ME SAID PRETTY!
clear: CLEAR SKY. GOOD DAY TA GET TINKZ DONE!
NICE DAY. GONNA EAT OUTSIDE. ON A BIG ROCK!
BLUE SKY, NO CLOUDS. SUSPICIOUS. ENJOYIN' IT ANYWAY!
WARM ON DA BACK. LIKE A BIG HAND!
SHIRT OFF WEATHER. NO HERE. NO IN TOWN!
CLEAR AS A BELL. CAN SEE DA HILLS FOR ONCE!
SUNNY. SQUINTIN'. LOOK ANGRIER DEN ME IZ!
FINE WEATHER. PEOPLE SMILE MORE. EVEN AT ME!
PERFECT DAY FOR {FISHIN'|A WALK|A LONG LUNCH}!
SUN'S NICE. SHADE'S NICER. BIG SHADOW, THOUGH!
WASHIN' DRIES FAST TODAY. GOT A LOT OF WASHIN'!
GOOD LIGHT. CAN READ DA LIL' PRINT FOR ONCE!
TOO NICE TA STAY IN. TOO NICE TA WORK. WORKIN' ANYWAY!

morning: UP BEFORE DA BIRDS. OLD HABIT FROM DA CAMP!
MORNINGS IZ FOR GRUNTIN'. TALKIN' STARTS AT TEN!
FRESH BREAD SMELL. FOLLOWIN' IT AGAIN!
SHAVED ROUND DA TUSKS. NICKED ONE. OW!
EARLY TRAM. SAME FACES. NOD, NOD, NOD!
GOBLIN HEAD'S QUIET IN DA MORNINGS. DEY SLEEP LATE!
MORNIN' AIR'S SHARP. WAKES DA TUSKS UP!
NEW DAY. NO HAB SHOUTED AT ANYONE YET. GOOD START!
STRETCHED. BACK CRACKED LIKE A BRANCH. BETTER!
MORNIN' PAPER, MORNIN' TEA, MORNIN' GRUMBLE!
SLEPT THROUGH DA ALARM. ALARM'S IN PIECES. NO ME FAULT!
SUN'S BARELY UP. ALREADY GOT STUFF DONE!
DEW ON DA BOOTS. FRESH START!
afternoon: HALF DA DAY DONE. OTHER HALF'S WAITIN'!
SUN'S HIGH. SHADE'S TAKEN. BY ME!
AFTERNOON'S FOR HEAVY LIFTIN'. MUSCLES IZ WARM!
NOBODY'S IN A HURRY DIS TIME OF DAY. GOOD!
TEA BREAK. FIVE SUGARS. TWO BISCUITS. FINE, FOUR!
YAWNED IN FRONT OF A CUSTOMER. TUSKS OUT. CUSTOMER LEFT!
LAZY HOUR. GOOD FOR THINKIN'. OR NO!
MIDDLE OF DA DAY. MIDDLE OF DA ROAD. MIDDLE OF EVERYTINK, ME!
KIDS OUT OF SCHOOL. NOISE. GOOD NOISE!
AFTERNOON LIGHT MAKES DA CITY GOLD. EVEN DA BINS!
HALFWAY THROUGH AN' STILL IN A GOOD MOOD. RECORD!
evening: PUB'S WARMIN' UP. SO IZ ME!
SUNSET. SKY'S DA COLOUR OF GOBLIN WAR PAINT. NO SAYIN' DAT OUT LOUD!
DAY'S DONE. DID IT RIGHT. GOOD!
EVENIN' WALK. STREETLAMPS FLICKER ON AS ME PASS. NO ME. MAYBE-MAYBE!
GOBLIN HEAD WAKIN' UP. DEY LIKE DA DARK!
LAMPS ON. SHADOWS BIG. ME BIGGEST!
GOOD TIRED. DA RIGHT KIND, AFTER A FULL DAY!
WASHED UP. DRIED UP. SAT DOWN. DONE!
SMELL OF EVERYONE'S DINNER IN DA STREET. HUNGRY AGAIN!
COOLER NOW. NICE. GOOD FOR A LONG WALK HOME!
night: DARK STREETS. PEOPLE CROSS DA ROAD. NO ME FAULT ME IZ BIG!
NIGHT SHIFT. COFFEE AN' A TORCH!
STARS OUT. SOMEWHERE UP NORTH DEY IZ DRUMMIN'!
GOOD ORC EYES. SEE FINE IN DA DARK. GOBLIN BIT'S USEFUL!
LATE. SHOULD BE IN BED. IZ NO!
WALKED A LADY HOME. SHE WAZ SCARED OF DA DARK, DEN OF ME, DEN FINE!
MOON'S BIG. MAKES ME WANT TA SING. NO WILL!
OWLS. CATS. ME. DA NIGHT CREW!
MIDNIGHT SNACK. DEN ANOTHER. DEN BED!
STREETS EMPTY. FINALLY ROOM TA WALK!
DREAMS TONIGHT WILL BE LOUD. ALWAYS IZ!
LOCK DA DOOR, CHECK DA LOCK, CHECK AGAIN!

SPRING: SPRING. PUMPKIN SEEDS IN. DIS YEAR DEY WILL BE HUGE!
COAT OFF. ARMS OUT. PEOPLE STARE. SPRING!
SPRING CLEANIN'. FOUND THREE LOST HATS!
BIRDS NESTIN' IN DA GUTTER. LEAVIN' DEM!
LAMBS IN DA FIELDS. CUTE. HUNGRY NOW. SHAME!
GOBLINS UP NORTH MOVE IN SPRING. PAPER WILL BE FULL OF IT!
LONGER DAYS. MORE WORK. MORE PUB!
RAIN AN' SUN EVERY TEN MINUTES. MAKE UP YA MIND!
SUMMER: TOO HOT FOR ARMOUR. TOO HOT FOR SHIRTS. TOO HOT!
ICE CREAM. FOUR SCOOPS. LIL' CONE. DISASTER!
LAKE SWIM. DISPLACED HALF DA WATER!
LONG EVENINGS, COLD BEER, WARM STONE. GOOD!
SUNBURNT ON DA EARS. EVERY YEAR!
SUMMER FESTIVAL. TUG OF WAR. ME IZ BANNED!
FLIES LOVE ME. NO KNOW WHY!
TOO HOT TA BE GRUMPY. TOO HOT TA BE ANYTINK!
AUTUMN: LEAVES EVERYWHERE. KICKIN' DEM. GROWN ORC. NO CARE!
WIND'S GETTIN' COLD. BIG COAT OUT OF DA CUPBOARD!
HARVEST WORK. LIFTIN' SACKS. GOOD PAY, SORE BACK!
GEESE GOING SOUTH. GOBLINS GOING SOUTH TOO. DIFFERENT REASONS!
DARK BY TEA TIME. LAMPS EARLY!
CHESTNUTS ROASTIN'. BURNT ME FINGERS. WORTH IT!
FOG IN DA MORNINGS. NO CAN SEE ME OWN FEET. FAR DOWN DERE!
WINTER: WINTER. THREE BLANKETS. FEET STILL STICK OUT!
COLD ENOUGH TA CRACK TUSKS. ME HOLD. TOUGH TUSKS!
CHRISTMAS SOON. MUM'S SIDE WANTS A FEAST, DAD'S SIDE WANTS CAROLS. BOTH, LOUD!
FIRE'S LIT. NO MOVIN' TILL MARCH!
ICE ON DA WINDOWS. BREATH ON DA GLASS. DREW A GOBLIN!
WINTER'S WHEN DA HORDE GETS RESTLESS. PAPER SAYS SO EVERY YEAR!
SHORT DAYS. LONG NIGHTS. LONG NAPS!
SHOVELLIN' SNOW FOR DA OLD FOLKS. PAYS IN CAKE!
WOOL SOCKS, TWO PAIRS. BOOTS BARELY CLOSE!

poor: BREAD AN' WATER AGAIN. STRONG ORCS NO NEED MUCH. LIE!
SHOES HAB HOLES. TOES SAY HELLO!
GOBLIN CAMPS FEED EVERYONE. THOUGHT 'BOUT IT. NO!
SLEEPIN' IN A ROOM WIT FOUR OTHERS. SNORIN' CONTEST. ME WIN!
MENDED ME COAT AGAIN. MORE PATCH DEN COAT!
CHEAPEST STEW IN TOWN. MOSTLY WATER. SOME HOPE!
DAY LABOUR LINE. GET PICKED FIRST, EVERY TIME. LIL' MERCY!
OWE {DA LANDLORD|DA BAKER|ME COUSIN}. WILL PAY. ALWAYS PAY!
COUNTIN' COINS FOR DA BUS. WALKIN' INSTEAD!
LAZY IZ WHAT IZ SHAMEFUL. AN' ME IZ NEVER LAZY!
